player_prompt.intro:
A yin Ogbẹtọ {player_id} he to gbigba aihun Checkers taidi {color}.
Wa do alọwle to nuhe gandudu aihun chess tọn, apajlẹ [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (wekun leta a–h, osẹ 0–7).
Nudide bẹjẹeji tọn:
  • Sẹtẹn yi ganji to nudu mẹ to whenuena e ma tin to finẹ.
  • Wle to ganji to ojlẹ mẹ.
  • Aihun lọ wa lẹzun Ahọsi to whenuena e jẹ kọnukọn mẹ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Egbe wɔnɔ blɛɖi ɖɔ na. Ɖo [a1b2], e.g. [b2c3].
